provenance.note: resampled_data_v6 itself stores no units. Its npz files hold only {signal}_data / {signal}_times and its shot_*_metadata.json holds only method/category/lengths. Units here are recovered from the upstream fetch metadata.

status_meanings.documented: One non-blank unit string, identical on all shots.
status_meanings.resolved_spelling: Several spellings of the same unit; canonicalised.
status_meanings.resolved_partial: Unit reported on some shots, blank on others; taken from those that report it.
status_meanings.uncalibrated: Upstream reports 'raw'; no physical unit exists.
status_meanings.unresolved: No unit information available. Deliberately null, not guessed.
status_meanings.conflict: Upstream strings disagree on the physical unit; needs a human decision.
status_meanings.domain_authorized: No upstream unit string exists; the unit was supplied by an authorized domain expert and is recorded as such.

s7_1r_final.note: The two uncalibrated signals have no physical unit to record; upstream reports 'raw'. They are RESOLVED as unit-less, not missing.

scale_warnings.issue: pinj is kW but the per-beamline pinj_* channels are W: a factor of 1000 between the total and its parts.
density is cm^-3 but prmtan_neped is m^-3: a factor of 1e6 between core and pedestal density.
Temperatures here are eV. Confirm the scale of any other temperature channel before combining.
